screens.name: Home
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 shows a dominant orb and disclosed unavailable omen; supplied runtime reports reduced-motion coverage; provisional A=8.3, F=7.3, overall=7.7.
findings: Strengthen the small instruction and omen-status text while preserving the clear orb-led composition.

screens.name: Approach/loading entrance
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 preserves composition between transition and settled captures, and supplied runtime reports automatic advancement after 650ms or immediately with reduced motion; provisional A=8.3, F=7.3, overall=7.7.
findings: Make “Opening your question” more legible so “Come closer” does not suggest an additional required gesture.

screens.name: Listening/voice failure
screens.evidence: Sheet 08 shows a prominent typing fallback and persistent microphone-error notice, while supplied runtime reports transcription preservation; provisional A=8.0, F=7.7, overall=7.8.
findings: Place the failure explanation nearer the fallback actions to reduce the distance between cause and recovery.

screens.name: Ask/normal input
screens.evidence: Sheets 01–02 show a labeled populated field and distinct submission action with stable transition placement; provisional A=8.0, F=7.7, overall=7.8.
findings: Replace “prediction engine” in the disclosure with plain language explaining where questions and answers go.

screens.name: Ask/200% text
screens.evidence: Sheet 01 shows the entire enlarged question and submission button, and supplied form evidence reports retained context and visible submission; provisional A=8.0, F=8.0, overall=8.0.
findings: Verify this reflow with native text enlargement and a physical keyboard before treating browser enlargement as device coverage.

screens.name: Question card 1/plan readiness
screens.evidence: Sheet 02 shows stable transition geometry, numbered progress and four divided answers, with immediate advancement reported in runtime evidence; provisional A=8.3, F=7.0, overall=7.5.
findings: Use answer labels on one readiness scale because “Nearly certain” describes confidence rather than plan completion.

screens.name: Question card 2/obstacle
screens.evidence: Sheets 02–03 show consistent option spacing and 2-of-3 progress, but no captured pressed or selected answer state; provisional A=8.3, F=7.3, overall=7.7.
findings: Verify that immediate advancement communicates the chosen answer and permits an understandable return to it.

screens.name: Question card 3/support
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 retains the same question layout through transition and shows 3-of-3 progress with a custom-answer escape; provisional A=8.3, F=7.3, overall=7.7.
findings: Clarify that selecting the final answer starts the reading rather than another question.

screens.name: Custom answer/empty
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 shows question context, Change, an empty multiline field and disabled Continue, while runtime reports text retention after changing choices; provisional A=8.0, F=7.7, overall=7.8.
findings: Rename “Change” to “Choose an answer” to make its destination explicit.

screens.name: Custom answer/empty 200%
screens.evidence: Sheet 03 shows the enlarged question, field and disabled Continue within the captured viewport; provisional A=8.0, F=8.0, overall=8.0.
findings: Preserve this full question context when the native keyboard opens.

screens.name: Custom answer/filled 200%
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 shows readable multiline content and an enabled wrapped Reveal action, supported by supplied large-form checks; provisional A=8.0, F=8.0, overall=8.0.
findings: Confirm that longer entered answers remain reviewable without obscuring the submission action.

screens.name: Custom answer/synthetic keyboard constraint
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 keeps the entered answer and Reveal action visible but crops question context, and runtime explicitly identifies a synthetic 390×500 viewport; provisional A=7.3, F=7.3, overall=7.3.
findings: Keep the question and Change control recoverable in the constrained viewport and verify actual keyboard safe areas on a phone.

screens.name: Planning/loading
screens.evidence: Sheets 09–10 show consistent loading composition, stage text, an expected wait and cancellation, with supplied motion checks covering this stage; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Increase the legibility of the wait and reading-credit reassurance beneath the main status.

screens.name: Research/loading
screens.evidence: Sheet 10 distinguishes research through status text while retaining the planning layout and Cancel action; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Verify that the change from question checking to research is announced to assistive technology.

screens.name: Planning error
screens.evidence: Sheets 05–06 show an explicit failure, no-charge reassurance and separate retry/edit paths using labeled fixture text; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Verify that retry retains the original question and moves focus to the resulting status.

screens.name: Prediction error
screens.evidence: Sheet 06 adds Review answers to the stable retry/edit error layout, with connection recovery reported in supplied runtime evidence; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Verify that Review answers restores the completed answers and provides a clear route back to retry.

screens.name: Reveal
screens.evidence: Sheets 10–11 show a dim transitional headline resolving into a readable result with uncertainty, explanation and sharing actions; provisional A=8.0, F=7.7, overall=7.8.
findings: Keep the animated mist behind the result consistently subdued so headline and utility-text contrast remain stable.

screens.name: Reveal/expanded Why
screens.evidence: Sheet 11 shows an explicit expanded state and readable explanation beginning below a large result header, with expansion exercised in supplied runtime evidence; provisional A=7.3, F=7.7, overall=7.5.
findings: Reduce the repeated hero/header footprint when expanded so more explanation is visible without scrolling.

screens.name: Check-in/outcome
screens.evidence: Sheet 04 places three outcome answers adjacent to the saved result, and supplied runtime reports outcome persistence without showing its selected confirmation here; provisional A=8.0, F=7.3, overall=7.6.
findings: Show a persistent selected outcome and clear saved confirmation after Yes, Not quite or Not yet.

screens.name: History/empty
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows a calm empty state, local-storage disclosure and Ask action with consistent transition placement; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Give the empty-state Ask action stronger visual prominence as the screen’s next step.

screens.name: History/populated
screens.evidence: Sheets 06–07 show a dated question/result row with Waiting status, supported by reported history persistence; provisional A=8.3, F=7.3, overall=7.7.
findings: Replace “Waiting” with a specific outcome or check-in status and make opening the row more evident.

screens.name: History/stress list
screens.evidence: Sheet 07 shows repeated dated entries continuing behind the fixed navigation, while supplied layout checks do not establish final-row scroll clearance; provisional A=8.3, F=7.3, overall=7.7.
findings: Verify that the final history entry can scroll fully above the raised central navigation orb.

screens.name: Sky/sample offline
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 explicitly identifies offline samples and shows a checkmarked Love selection with its question and Ask action; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Verify generous labeled hit areas and a meaningful reading order for the spatially arranged stars.

screens.name: Circles/offline
screens.evidence: Sheet 05 discloses the outage and sharing boundaries, and supplied control evidence confirms circle creation is disabled; provisional A=8.0, F=7.7, overall=7.8.
findings: Explain beside each disabled control whether it is unavailable because of connectivity or account-age eligibility.

screens.name: Plans/normal
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 shows explicit simulated billing and selected annual pricing, but the settled capture cuts through the decorative orb beneath the header; provisional A=7.7, F=7.7, overall=7.7.
findings: Remove or fully contain the decorative orb so the settled plans header does not look accidentally clipped.

screens.name: Plans/200%
screens.evidence: Sheet 09 shows stacked readable pricing, annual selection and a fully visible enlarged simulation action; provisional A=8.0, F=8.0, overall=8.0.
findings: Verify that pack options and any remaining billing information are reachable below the enlarged primary action.

screens.name: Sensitive redirect/planning
screens.evidence: Sheets 11–12 show a distinct redirect, support link and no-reading/no-memory reassurance, with a real redirect reported in runtime evidence; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Give the support route greater emphasis when it is the contextually appropriate next action.

screens.name: Sensitive redirect/prediction
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 preserves the redirect actions through prediction-stage mist, although this separate branch’s live behavior is not specifically established; provisional A=8.0, F=7.7, overall=7.8.
findings: Verify the prediction-stage redirect independently, including its support destination and preserved no-charge state.

screens.name: You/settings/empty memory
screens.evidence: Sheets 13 and 15 show grouped preferences and empty memory, with supplied evidence confirming 342×52px preference targets, keyboard operation and persistence; provisional A=8.3, F=8.0, overall=8.1.
findings: Ensure the Privacy and entertainment row can clear the bottom navigation rather than remain partially covered.

screens.name: Settings/keyboard focus
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 shows a clear full-row focus outline, and supplied control checks report label, Space and Enter activation; provisional A=8.3, F=8.0, overall=8.1.
findings: Confirm equally visible focus and unobscured focused content on every settings and navigation control.

screens.name: Settings/200%
screens.evidence: Sheet 12 shows enlarged preference labels and selected large text, with content visibly intersecting the fixed header and lower navigation edges; provisional A=7.3, F=7.7, overall=7.5.
findings: Verify scroll padding at both fixed edges so enlarged rows and their focus outlines can be read completely.

screens.name: Share
screens.evidence: Sheet 13 shows a consistent preview and labeled export choices, while supplied runtime proves PNG export and injected-error recovery but not every listed delivery mode; provisional A=8.0, F=7.7, overall=7.8.
findings: Verify video and private-link availability separately and communicate any unavailable destination before activation.

screens.name: Story/export preview
screens.evidence: Sheet 14 shows a readable story composition and Export action, supported by reported real 1080×1920 PNG generation and error recovery; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Verify that export completion clearly identifies where the image went without relying on unverified OS share delivery.

components.name: Hero orb
components.evidence: The sheets consistently use the gold orb as the hero, and supplied runtime covers canvas performance and reduced-motion stopping; provisional A=9.0, F=7.3, overall=8.0.
findings: Make the interactive Home orb’s action and focus distinguishable from decorative instances.

components.name: Tab bar
components.evidence: Sheets 07–08 and 13–15 show labeled destinations and selected underlines, with a raised Ask orb overlapping the content boundary; provisional A=7.7, F=7.7, overall=7.7.

components.name: Wordmark/balance header
components.evidence: The sheets show consistent title/balance placement and different remaining balances across reading states, with successful consumption reported in runtime evidence; provisional A=8.0, F=7.3, overall=7.6.
findings: Use “1 reading left today” where space permits and verify the enlarged balance never competes with the page title.

components.name: Primary button
components.evidence: The cream buttons remain prominent across normal and enlarged states, with visible enabled/disabled variants and several actions exercised in supplied runtime evidence; provisional A=8.7, F=8.0, overall=8.3.
findings: Verify pressed, focused and busy states consistently across all primary actions, beyond the captured enabled and disabled examples.

components.name: Secondary action
components.evidence: Gold links and divided action rows recur throughout the sheets, but their hit areas and interaction states are not individually established; provisional A=7.7, F=7.0, overall=7.3.
findings: Standardize secondary-action hit areas and replace ambiguous labels such as Change and Waiting where they imply an action.

components.name: Answer choice
components.evidence: Sheets 02–03 show generous divided rows, while runtime reports immediate advancement without a supplied selected-choice capture; provisional A=8.3, F=7.3, overall=7.7.
findings: Provide perceptible selection acknowledgement and verify retained selection on backward navigation.

components.name: Question input
components.evidence: Sheets 01–04 show labeled multiline fields with strong boundaries, and supplied runtime reports typed-text preservation; provisional A=8.0, F=7.7, overall=7.8.
findings: Keep the focus treatment visibly distinct from the field’s persistent gold border.

components.name: Large-text input
components.evidence: Sheets 01, 03 and 05 show successful multiline enlargement, but the synthetic keyboard capture loses visible question context; provisional A=8.0, F=7.7, overall=7.8.
findings: Verify long-answer editing, caret visibility and recoverable question context with a real mobile keyboard.

components.name: Settings switch
components.evidence: Sheets 12–13 show position-and-color state changes and row focus, supported by supplied target-size, keyboard and persistence checks; provisional A=8.0, F=8.0, overall=8.0.
findings: Verify accessible names and state announcements with VoiceOver and TalkBack.

components.name: Omen content
components.evidence: Sheet 08 shows only an explicitly unavailable omen with a next-day instruction, leaving the populated component unrepresented; provisional A=7.3, F=7.3, overall=7.3.
findings: Add evidence for a populated omen and clarify whether waiting until tomorrow is the intended recovery.

components.name: Sky star/selected question
components.evidence: Sheet 14 links a checkmarked category to a displayed sample question and prominent Ask action, without proving star target dimensions; provisional A=8.3, F=7.7, overall=7.9.
findings: Verify each star-label pair has a sufficiently large target and exposes its selected state beyond visual styling.

components.name: Circle surface
components.evidence: Sheet 05 provides explicit offline and privacy messaging with disabled creation, but no connected or populated circle surface; provisional A=8.0, F=7.7, overall=7.8.
findings: Evaluate connected creation, invitation and populated-circle states separately when backend access is available.

components.name: History row
components.evidence: Sheets 06–07 separate date, original question and result cleanly, but show only a generic Waiting status and no row interaction state; provisional A=8.3, F=7.0, overall=7.5.
findings: Make row activation evident and replace Waiting with a specific check-in or outcome label.

components.name: Plan option
components.evidence: Sheet 09 shows annual selection through a checkmark and divider, readable billing cadence and enlarged reflow, with simulated purchases reported; provisional A=8.0, F=7.7, overall=7.8.
findings: Verify keyboard selection and accessible selected-state announcements independently of simulated purchase completion.

components.name: Share preview/card
components.evidence: Sheets 13–14 show a coherent export card whose caveats become very small in the share thumbnail, with actual PNG generation reported; provisional A=8.0, F=7.7, overall=7.8.
findings: Keep the speculative caveat readable at common receiving-app display sizes, not only in the full export.

components.name: Notice/recovery
components.evidence: The sheets distinguish voice failure, offline data, reading errors and sensitive redirects, with selected recovery paths exercised in supplied runtime evidence; provisional A=8.0, F=7.7, overall=7.8.
findings: Verify notices receive appropriate assistive announcements and keep their recovery actions near the explanation.

components.name: Typography/spacing system
components.evidence: The sheets consistently separate expressive serif headings from utility text and show 200% variants, while small muted labels remain visually weaker; provisional A=8.3, F=7.5, overall=7.8.
findings: Increase small utility-text contrast and verify text spacing and native enlargement in addition to the app’s 200% mode.

components.name: Atmospheric background
components.evidence: The sheets sustain borderless dark mist but show brighter smoke behind reveal content, with supplied runtime reporting smooth rendering and actual reduced-motion stopping; provisional A=8.0, F=7.0, overall=7.4.
findings: Constrain mist luminance behind text so readability remains stable throughout the animation.

limitations: All grades are provisional; screenshots were inspected directly, while runtime results are supplied evidence rather than independently rerun checks.
The authorized A≥9 and F≥9 threshold is not met; physical-device and assistive-technology evidence also precludes 9/10 certification.
No confirmed hard-gate failure is established by these materials; visible clipping and navigation overlap require scroll and focus checks before they can be classified as inaccessible content.
Transition pairs support compositional continuity, but still images cannot establish animation timing, intermediate contrast, focus continuity or absence of every layout shift.
Physical iPhone Safari, native Dynamic Type, keyboard safe areas, VoiceOver/TalkBack, microphone hardware, haptics, real payments and OS share delivery remain unverified.
Social surfaces are explicitly offline; connected circles, authentication, invitation and private-link delivery are not established.
Fixture predictions and repeated explanation text are layout evidence, not production-copy defects or evidence of predictive or semantic quality.
Populated memory, successful omen content, selected outcome confirmation and several pressed/busy states lack corresponding screenshots.
A and F are normalized over applicable dimensions, and overall scores use 0.4A + 0.6F before rounding; null denotes only genuinely inapplicable dimensions.
topFixes: Resolve or verify content clearance around fixed headers and the raised tab orb, especially in enlarged settings and long history.
Preserve recoverable question context and Change controls under a real mobile keyboard at enlarged text sizes.
Strengthen small utility text and keep mist luminance from varying text contrast.
Make immediate answer selection, saved outcomes and history status explicit and persistent.
Remove the clipped plans orb and reduce the hero footprint in expanded explanations.
Complete physical-phone and screen-reader verification before seeking the authorized 9/9 threshold.
